```ts
  // Percent-encoded sequences (e.g. `%0D%0A`) are already safe and are left as-is.
  locationString.replace(/\r/g, '%0D').replace(/\n/g, '%0A')
)
```

Ordering matters: the multibyte `encodeURI` pass runs first (it also escapes CR/LF when it fires), then the CR/LF replacement is a no-op-safe backstop for Latin-1 paths where `encodeURI` is skipped — that was the injection hole, since `String(location)` was passed through verbatim.
